item.title: After They Left: Living in the Shadows
item.description: They came, did their thing, and left. Now all we have is the debris, the silence, and the questions that won’t go away.

item.title: While They Stayed: The World in Chaos
item.description: They were here for a few hours, and the world couldn’t handle it. This is what it was like while they stayed.
